note: Track beat (theory-basics), step 4, on the clap-along tool at level intermediate (sixteenths): one short round of "1 e & a", counted aloud first and then in the head, kept to three minutes so it sits beside the singing or playing in a plan. The rests of this step stay with theory-intermediate-sixteenths-and-rests. It states its moves (tempo 50 to 80) and mentions no selector.

exercise.title: Sixteenths on the lane: 1 e & a
exercise.why: Four taps to a beat are easy to rush, and the lane marks each tap against its own note, so you can see which of the four drifts.

cells.text:
Press Start below to begin a round of sixteenths at {{=bpm}}: four notes to every beat. Count "1 e & a, 2 e & a" aloud, saying "and" for each &, and tap on every word with Space or on the lane.
Once the four taps sit evenly, stop saying the count and hear it in your head instead.
